title: Salt Desert Silence
subtitle: A Tamburins oasis in the heart of Busan.
line: Step into the silent, white expanse where the memory of a salt desert breathes life into scent.
quote: In the white quiet, fragrance is the only thing that speaks.
synopsis: You walk along the glossy path, crossing a field of infinite white. Before you stands the salt crystal monolith, an abstract beacon in the desert. As you wander among the scent-filled plinths, you discover fragrances hidden in the monochromatic landscape. Finally, you reach the minimal transaction block, where the silence remains unbroken.

why.t: The glossy path guides your feet, separating
why.d: A floor strip (path through the desert) runs 4.7 m from the door toward the hero (salt crystal monolith). The glossy path guides your feet, separating the entry from the vast, open space.

why.t: The towering monolith commands the room
why.d: The hero stands alone 5.6 m inside the door, 3.5 m tall; nothing else rises above 1.8 m. The towering monolith commands the room, drawing your eyes across the emptiness.

why.t: Surrounding the monolith, the subtle plinths
why.d: Four product stations (hidden scent plinths) ring it loosely, 0.4 m from the route at the closest. Surrounding the monolith, the subtle plinths require you to lean in to discover their hidden scents.
The pay counter (minimal transaction block) sits at the back right, where the route ends. The low-profile counter at the back completes your journey without disrupting the minimalist horizon.
